title: Kestrel Cash Reward Terms for Kestrel Care Rewards Members
content:
Kestrel Cash is the spendable reward of **Kestrel Care Rewards**, held in US dollars on the membership. These terms govern how points become Kestrel Cash, how long a reward stays usable, and how much of it may be applied to a purchase.

## Terms

**(a) Conversion.** Where automatic conversion applies, every whole block of the level's block size in points converts to the level's cash-per-block amount of Kestrel Cash, on the day the points balance reaches a block. Leftover points below a whole block stay in the points balance. The Kestrel Cash issued on a conversion is the points converted, divided by the block size, multiplied by the cash per block.

**(b) Validity.** A Kestrel Cash reward is usable for the level's validity period from issue. The monthly Plus credit is usable for the monthly-credit validity period instead. Each reward carries an expiration date, which is the last day it can be used; the reward expires on the day after its expiration date for whatever part of it is unused.

**(c) Use on a purchase.** No more than the level's per-purchase maximum is applied to one purchase, and the oldest reward is used first.

**(d) Prescription copays.** Where Kestrel Cash is not redeemable on a prescription copay, Kestrel Cash never pays a prescription copay.

**(e) No cash value.** Kestrel Cash has no cash value and is never paid out.

## Schedule by level

| | Member | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Plus Monthly | Plus Annual |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Automatic conversion of whole blocks | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Block size (points) | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 |
| Kestrel Cash per block (USD) | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| Validity of a Kestrel Cash reward (calendar days from issue) | 30 | 30 | 45 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Validity of the monthly Plus credit (calendar days) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 | 30 |
| Most Kestrel Cash applied to one purchase (USD) | 25.00 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 100.00 | 100.00 | 100.00 |
| Kestrel Cash redeemable on a prescription copay | no | no | no | no | no | no |

The columns are Kestrel Care Rewards Member, Kestrel Care Rewards Silver, Kestrel Care Rewards Gold, Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum, Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly and Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual.

## Worked examples (hypothetical balances, amounts and dates)

**Conversion.** A member's points balance stands at 850 and a credit of 1500 points posts, bringing it to 2350. The balance has reached two whole blocks of 1000, so 2000 points convert that day: 2000 divided by 1000, multiplied by 1.00, issues 2.00 of Kestrel Cash. The remaining 350 points stay in the balance.

**Expiry.** A reward's expiration date is 15 July. It can be used up to and including 15 July; whatever is unused expires on 16 July.

**Per-purchase maximum and oldest first.** A member at Kestrel Care Rewards Gold holds two rewards: 30.00 issued in March and 40.00 issued in April. On an 80.00 purchase no more than 50.00 is applied. The March reward is used first, for 30.00, and the April reward supplies the remaining 20.00, leaving 20.00 on the April reward.

## Points of judgement

- **Paying a prescription copay with Kestrel Cash.** Kestrel Cash is not redeemable on a prescription copay at any level, so it never pays one.
- **Asking for Kestrel Cash as money.** Kestrel Cash has no cash value and is never paid out.
- **900 points in the balance.** 900 is below a whole block of 1000, so nothing converts and the 900 points stay in the balance.
